result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred playbook limits: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber at USD 5M when Garman processes Sparkling data, workers’ compensation as required by law, and certificates on request. It preserves the existing headings and entire-agreement provisions. However, requiring all coverage to continue for one year after termination exceeds the stated playbook and is not necessary, particularly for occurrence-based CGL and workers’ compensation. Using the applicable defined term “Customer Data,” if available, would also be more precise than “Sparkling’s data.”
